# invoice-api

**Status:** Active · **Updated:** 2026-09-25 by /ship refunds

Flask service that lets finance staff export invoices, read reports, and refund
payments.

## Run it

| Task | Command                              |
| ---- | ------------------------------------ |
| run  | `uv run flask --app invoice_api run` |
| test | `uv run pytest`                      |
